# Alvaro Raditya Soewardono

Fullstack developer, robotics engineer, and cybersecurity specialist based in Jakarta, Indonesia. Automotive and Robotics Engineering student at BINUS ASO School of Engineering.

The site is a single-page SvelteKit portfolio at [alvaroswdn.my.id](https://alvaroswdn.my.id) with a hero/about section and a projects section. Built with SvelteKit, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and GSAP for scroll animations.
